complexity.notes: Clean and idiomatic. The in-place mutation of the copied list is fine since nums is rebound to a new list. Space can be reduced to O(1) by keeping only ||the previous two DP values in rolling variables|| instead of the whole array.
complexity.summary: Classic one-dimensional DP: after prepending a zero, each position takes the max of robbing the current house (plus the best two back) or skipping it (best one back), so the last entry holds the answer.
